subject: MAP: Acme evaluation & close playbook — week of Nov 28 update
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.in>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.in, marcus_lin@redwood.in, karthik_iyer@redwood.in
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: Acme evaluation & close playbook — week of Nov 28 update

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Quick weekly playbook update from our side. Keeping this tight so we can align on owners and due dates going into the final evaluation week. Attaching the latest MAP (v3) with the timeline column filled in — please flag anything that needs shifting.

Summary (high level):
- Goal: complete evaluation, finalize SOW and procurement, and sign by Dec 9 (internal close target).
- Current read: evaluation on-track but two risk items need follow-up: SOC2 evidence request and SSO verification.
- Next internal milestone: Redwood to deliver proposal redlines by Tue, Dec 1. Acme legal review to complete by Thu, Dec 3.

Decisions needed this week:
1) Confirmation of data retention SLA (30 vs 90 days) — Acme decision owner: Sarah
2) Which environment for integration testing (staging vs. dedicated sandbox) — Acme dev owner: Tom

Action items (owners / due dates):
- A1: Connor — upload and share MAP v3 and proposal redlines to shared Drive (Due: 2026-11-28) [Attachment: Acme_MAP_v3.xlsx]
- A2: Laura — prepare response to SOC2 evidence matrix (first pass) (Due: 2026-11-30) [Attachment: SOC2_evidence_request.pdf]
- A3: Marcus — schedule a 1-hour SSO troubleshooting session with Acme infra (Due: 2026-11-30)
- A4: Karthik — finalize pricing workbook for dedicated capacity scenarios (Due: 2026-12-01)

Meeting cadence: weekly MAP check-ins (same time) until sign. Next check-in: Mon, Nov 30, 10:00 AM PT — please confirm availability.

Attachments: Acme_MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP with timeline), SOC2_evidence_request.pdf (external questionnaire).

Thanks — short ask: Sarah, can you confirm the data retention preference and Tom, which test environment you want us to provision by EOW?

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.in | +1 (415) 555-0198
[Attachment stub: Acme_MAP_v3.xlsx (Excel, 38KB)]

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.in>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.in, marcus_lin@redwood.in, karthik_iyer@redwood.in
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Acme evaluation & close playbook — week of Nov 28 update

Connor —

Thanks for the clear update and the MAP. Quick responses inline: 

- Data retention: leaning toward 90 days for logs and inference artifacts (we need the longer window for troubleshooting). I will confirm formally by Tue EOD after checking with security.
- Test environment: Tom and I discussed — please provision a dedicated sandbox with SSO mirroring production (not the shared staging).

Two asks from Acme side:
1) Can Redwood provide example audit logs for 30/90-day retention so our security team can sign off?
2) We will send back a short redline doc on the proposal (expect one document with comments).

Also looping in Acme Legal (legal@acme.com) separately — they may have questions about the indemnity clause.

On availability: Mon Nov 30 at 10:00 AM PT works for me and Tom.

Best,
Sarah Lee
Head of Partnerships | Acme Corp
sarah.lee@acme.com

Sarah / Tom —

Thanks for the quick replies and confirming Monday's slot. A couple of updates from our side that change the owners/dates slightly: 

- SOC2 evidence: I completed a first-pass bundle — see attached PDF for the items we can provide immediately. I marked items that require timelines from our infra team. Action: Laura -> finalize and send complete bundle to Acme by Tue, Dec 1 EOD. [Attachment: SOC2_evidence_response_v1.pdf]
- Proposal redlines: Connor, I added inline comments to the doc you shared. Marcus will handle the commercial redlines with Acme Legal. Expect the Redwood consolidated response by Wed, Dec 2.
- SSO troubleshooting: Marcus has availability Wed 12/2 2:00–3:30 PM PT; Tom, does that window work? If yes, Marcus to send invite.

Revised action items (owners / due dates):
- A2.1: Laura — deliver SOC2 evidence bundle (Due: 2026-12-01 EOD)
- A1.1: Connor — incorporate Acme proposal comments and circulate consolidated redlines (Due: 2026-12-02) [Attachment: proposal-redlines.docx]
- A3.1: Marcus — SSO troubleshooting session invite (Due: 2026-12-01)

Decision notes: We should treat the data retention decision as gating for the SOC2 sign-off. If Acme chooses 90 days, it will require a minor configuration change; timeline remains feasible but requires Marcus + infra to prioritize.

Laura Bennett

Thanks everyone — short recap and confirmed owners/dates after today's check-in.

Decisions made (during Nov 30 MAP check-in):
- Acme confirmed data retention: 90 days for logs and inference artifacts (Decision owner: Sarah). This is gating for SOC2 sign-off.
- Test environment: Acme prefers a dedicated sandbox with SSO mirroring prod. Redwood to provision and prioritize SSO fix.

Finalized action items (owner — due):
- A1: Connor — circulate consolidated proposal redlines in a single doc (proposal-redlines.docx) (Due: 2026-12-02) — DONE (attached).
- A2: Laura — deliver SOC2 evidence bundle (Due: 2026-12-01 EOD) — IN PROGRESS
- A3: Marcus — SSO troubleshooting session with Tom (Scheduled: 2026-12-02 14:00 PT) — invite sent
- A4: Karthik — submit pricing workbook (two scenarios: shared hosted vs dedicated) (Due: 2026-12-01)
- A5: Connor + Acme Legal — align on indemnity redline conversation (target sync Thu, 2026-12-03)

Decisions that affect timeline: selecting 90-day retention adds a small implementation step but does not slide the close target; new sign target remains Dec 9. If anything materializes in legal redlines, we'll surface immediately.

Next week's MAP agenda (Dec 7 check-in):
- Status: SOC2 evidence acceptance and any follow-up items
- Commercial: final pricing scenario and procurement timeline
- Legal: outstanding indemnity redlines (if any)
- Cutover plan: post-sign sandbox provisioning checklist

Attachments referenced in thread: Acme_MAP_v3.xlsx, SOC2_evidence_request.pdf, proposal-redlines.docx
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567
Drive MAP: https://drive.google.com/open?id=abcd1234

Thanks all for the rapid turnaround this week. If anything changes overnight, flag in the HubSpot deal comments and I'll pick up.
